# Phase Start Checklist

Use this before beginning implementation for a new phase.

## Gate

- Confirm the active phase
- Confirm all earlier blocking gaps are resolved or explicitly accepted
- Confirm the phase spec exists
- Confirm the phase spec status is `Approved`
- Confirm non-goals are explicit

## Scope

- Write the phase goal in one sentence
- List what this phase will not do
- Identify the single capability unlock this phase owns
- Check that future-phase ideas have been deferred to the backlog

## Implementation Readiness

- Define the interfaces/contracts affected
- Define acceptance criteria
- Define verification evidence required
- Define the test plan
- Define the senior review gate

## Operating Discipline

- Use Build Mode during implementation
- Use Review Mode before milestone acceptance, including the default simplicity-and-truthfulness lens
- Keep proof artifacts under `verification/`
- Write a compaction after meaningful milestones
